description:
Step into a realm of refined living, where luxury blends with the serenity of the Mediterranean in this exceptional collection of luxury Benalmadena apartments for sale with sea views, where contemporary design harmonises with the peaceful coastal lifestyle.

This exclusive boutique project offers only sixteen 3- and 4-bedroom beachside homes, each boasting expansive terraces with a desirable south-facing orientation and breathtaking sea views. Designed with avant-garde architecture, these homes blend indoor and outdoor living, allowing you to immerse yourself in the stunning coastal skyline from the comfort of your living space. Every detail has been thoughtfully considered to enhance your quality of life, from the customisable open-plan kitchens to the use of natural finishes that radiate elegance and sophistication.

These apartments perfectly balance beauty and functionality, featuring high-quality materials and sustainable construction. The spacious layouts are designed to optimise light, comfort, and privacy, offering you the chance to personalise every detail, from the materials to the finishes, to suit your unique style. Residents enjoy premium amenities, including a wellness centre with a state-of-the-art gym, a Finnish sauna, and an eco-friendly, chlorine-free saline pool. The fully enclosed complex ensures security and convenience, with 24-hour CCTV access and pre-installed electric vehicle charging points.

Located just 300 metres from the beach, this beachside development is ideally positioned to provide easy access to a variety of services, including international schools, a golf course, supermarkets, public transport, and an excellent selection of dining options.

Benalmadena, situated on the sunny Costa del Sol, blends traditional Andalusian charm with modern conveniences. Its stunning coastline, golden beaches, and vibrant, family-friendly marina make it a sought-after destination for relaxation and recreation. The town offers world-class golf courses, fine dining, and cultural attractions like Benalmadena Pueblo with its charming cobblestone streets. With excellent transport links, including a nearby train station connecting Malaga and Fuengirola, easy motorway access to Marbella and beyond, and proximity to Malaga airport, Benalmadena is an ideal location for both permanent residents and holidaymakers.
